verdict.rationale: Fivetran's official MCP server lets an AI client answer natural-language questions about the account, such as sync status or broken connections. Setting FIVETRAN_SCOPE unlocks write and delete operations, including copying connections to a new destination. Connector SDK plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and Copilot CLIs also let users build, test and deploy connectors through natural-language prompts. Missing for 10: a native in-dashboard natural-language command interface (operation depends on an external MCP or agent client, and is read-only by default), and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably.
